We need propose retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We need to output JSON route with type mol, children reaction nodes etc. Need to select appropriate template IDs. We don't have list of IDs; we can search. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria to find templates for sulfonamide formation (break S-N bond forward, so retrosynthesis break S-N). Also amide formation (break C-N bond). Also Doebner modification (break C-C bond? Actually forward forms α,β-unsaturated acid from aldehyde + malonic acid; retrosynthesis would break C=C and C=O? Might be easier: we can propose disconnections: target has sulfonamide linking p-tolyl sulfonyl to phenyl ring with unsaturated amide side chain. So retrosynthesis steps:

1. Disconnection of sulfonamide: break S-N bond to give sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonic acid) and aniline. So precursor 1: p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride (or p-tolyl sulfonic acid) attached to phenyl ring? Actually the sulfonamide attaches to an aniline (the tolyl ring with NSO2...). The sulfonyl part is attached to phenyl ring (c2ccc...). So we can break to give p-toluidine (the aniline with methyl) and aryl sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonic acid) bearing the rest of molecule (aryl with unsaturated amide). So step 1: sulfonamide formation.

2. Next disconnection: amide bond between carbonyl and aniline (Nc3ccccc3N). So break C-N amide to give carboxylic acid (the α,β-unsaturated acid) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). So step 2: amide coupling.

3. The α,β-unsaturated acid can be formed via Doebner modification from aromatic aldehyde (the phenyl ring with aldehyde) and malonic acid. So break C=C double bond to give aldehyde and malonic acid. So step 3: Doebner modification.

Thus three steps.

We need template IDs. We can search for each transformation.

First, get functional groups list? Not needed.

Search for sulfonamide formation: functional_groups_broken maybe "sulfonamide". Let's search.


We'll call search_template_catalog_by_criteria with target SMILES and functional_groups_broken = ["sulfonamide"] maybe.
